_comment: Bundled public-source registry. Hash pinning is opt-in: leave 'sha256' as null to skip hash verification on import; populate it (or use 'import --pin-hash') to verify on subsequent fetches. URLs point at canonical upstream sources; texts are NEVER bundled in this repo.
